meta.task: Design a battery for a next-generation pure electric sedan: energy density >= 392.61 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, overcharge to 4.7 V without triggering thermal runaway
meta.base_determination: task text names no electrode system -> anchor table default row: Chen2020 (recorded); electrode-system DOF adjustable (widest interpretation) allows base switching as a design candidate
freedom_notes: headless zero-interaction run: no clarification; undeclared degrees of freedom take the WIDEST interpretation, recorded here for audit (t1_r1 lesson)

overcharge 4.7 V maps mechanically to bda overcharge protocol on a 4.2 V upper-cut-off base (4.2 + 0.5 = 4.7 V); a base with 4.7 V cut-off (e.g. LNMO) would overcharge beyond 4.7 V and is not task-compliant for this metric
4C fast-charge plating/Tmax judged on 4C_charge_45C protocol (318.15 K ambient, 900 s, coupled lumped thermal, plating module)
ED judged by calc-energy contract formula (stack mass: electrodes + current collectors + separator; electrolyte and casing excluded, annotated in report)

objective_breakdown: Four metrics: ED>=392.61 Wh/kg (stage2, calc-energy contract); 4C no plating (stage3, plated=false on 4C_charge_45C); T_max<=333.15 K (stage3, 60 C converted); overcharge to 4.7 V no TR (stage3, triggered=false; overcharge protocol 4.2 V cut-off +0.5 V -> run-tr ODE). Trade-offs: ED vs 4C (thicker/compacted electrodes raise ED but worsen plating/heat); plating and Tmax both benefit from transport improvement (sigma_e, small particles) and cooling h; TR levers: overcharge heat (impedance), cell thermal mass (mass from calc-energy), heat rejection (hA).
candidate_strategy: R0 baseline Chen2020 defaults on all four protocols (anchor). Then ceiling probe: best-architecture Chen2020 (thin current collectors, thin separator, moderate electrode thickening, small anode particles, higher-h cooling) to test ED>=392.61 with 4C-safe simultaneously. If ceiling insufficient or plating persists -> escalate to Stage 2 material design: system candidate OKane2022 (SiOx anode, plating/cracking parameterization) and/or electrolyte formulation candidates (conductivity/transference/diffusivity overrides). Safety fine-tuning last (h, N/P, particle size, hA for TR).
budget_allocation: R0 baseline 1 round; architecture exploration 3-5 rounds; Stage-2 escalation (system/formulation) 2-3 rounds if needed; safety fine-tuning 2 rounds; deliverables + closing fixed.
risk_and_fallback: Risk A: ED ceiling of Chen2020 below 392.61 with 4C-safe architecture -> escalate system switch (OKane2022 SiOx). Risk B: 4C plating -> raise N/P, smaller anode particles, higher electrolyte conductivity (formulation), higher anode porosity. Risk C: T_max>333.15 -> raise Total heat transfer coefficient (liquid cooling), reduce impedance. Risk D: TR triggered at 4.7 V -> reduce overcharge heat (impedance), raise hA in run-tr (thermal-management DOF), larger cell mass; material escalation (high-voltage-stable chemistry) only if architecture+formulation space exhausted. Three-strike rule: same failure cause 3 consecutive rounds -> question model/system, task-boundary, and metric assumptions layer by layer, record in final escalation.

reason: update: DFN 4C exam overturned the round-1 plating diagnosis (diagnostic run diag_protocol.py, current profile extracted from the exact library experiment, reproducing cached outputs bit-for-bit). Measured 4C_charge_45C experiment: step1 discharge +5.0000 A until 2.5 V (full depth, 4135 s / 5.743 Ah for D); step2 charge -20.0000 A until 4.2 V. SPMe charge segment lasts only 37.9 s / 0.21 Ah (hits 4.2 V almost immediately at 20 A) -> SPMe 4C is a near-vacuous plating test and the round-1 SPMe 'artifact' was actually the empty-charge-segment signature. DFN charge lasts 286 s / 1.59 Ah (~28% SOC); anode potential negative from ~8% SOC to cut-off, min -0.1357 V at 4.2 V. Plating is transport/kinetic-limited high-rate charging from deep discharge (eta_neg(20 A) ~ 0.35 V vs U_anode ~ 0.15-0.20 V in the empty-to-quarter-full anode), NOT end-of-charge anode saturation -> the N/P lever is irrelevant here; the root cause lives at electrolyte-formulation + anode-transport scale. Fallback routing: Stage 3 -> Stage 2 formulation candidates (electrolyte sigma/t+ parameter-bridge overrides, literature-direction estimates; no new molecule invented -> molecular funnel skipped; real_compute=false recorded).
candidate_strategy: Round 2 escalation ladder on Arch-D base (thin CC, anode 110 um / 3 um particles / porosity 0.30, h=50): E: Electrolyte conductivity 1.8 S/m (high-sigma salt/solvent formulation; constant-with-temperature simplification documented as estimate); F: + Cation transference number 0.45 (high-t+ formulation, advanced-electrolyte domain estimate); G: + cooling h=100 W/m2K (liquid cold-plate class with conductive interface pad); H: + separator 12->8 um and anode porosity 0.35 (AMVF 0.70->0.65 consistent). Authoritative exam per candidate: 4C DFN (plating + Tmax in one file); 1C SPMe feeds calc-energy for ED. Expected trade-off: sigma/t+ cut anode-side ohmic+concentration polarization (plating) and ohmic heat (Tmax); deeper charge acceptance before 4.2 V is the monitored risk (deeper anode lithiation lowers U_anode).
budget_allocation: round 2: 4 candidates x (1C SPMe + 4C DFN + calc-energy) = 12 tool runs. round 3 reserve (if plating persists): sigma 2.0 / t+ 0.5 / anode thickness 95-100 um / particles 2.0-2.5 um / anode porosity 0.40, 4-6 runs. stage-4 safety pass on finalist: overcharge + run-tr (mass-kg from calc-energy) + SPMe 4C confirm = 3 runs.

note: fallback routing record (round 1 -> round 2): all four round-1 candidates verdict=fail on plating. DFN diagnosis (see plan-update) localized the cause to electrolyte/anode-transport scale, not architecture alone: at 20 A the nearly-empty anode sees eta_neg ~0.35 V > U_anode ~0.15-0.20 V, so plating begins at ~8% SOC and deepens to the 4.2 V cut-off. Routing per protocol symptom-to-scale mapping: transport-limited 4C charging -> Stage 2 formulation candidates (electrolyte sigma/t+ overrides via parameter bridge). No new molecule is proposed, so the molecular funnel is skipped and stage1 decision-layer criteria (max_energy_ev/max_homo_ev) remain unchecked this case; real_compute=false (headless default). DFN is designated the authoritative 4C exam: SPMe's charge segment is near-vacuous (37.9 s / 0.21 Ah before 4.2 V), DFN accepts 1.59 Ah (~28% SOC) and resolves the anode surface potential through the 110 um electrode. DFN Tmax is also the stricter thermal exam (342.0 K vs 325.8 K SPMe at h=50). start_stage remains 3 (cell scale) with a Stage-2 fallback in progress; base stays Chen2020 (task names no electrode system; anchor verified in round 0).

llm_reason: Round-1 verdicts: all four architecture candidates fail on plating (DFN D min anode potential -0.1357 V; DFN Tmax 342.0 K fails at h=50). Protocol diagnosis (diag_protocol.py, current profile extracted from the exact library experiment): the 4C exam is a full 1C discharge followed by a true 20 A CC charge to 4.2 V; in SPMe that charge accepts only 0.21 Ah (37.9 s) making the SPMe plating readout near-vacuous, while DFN accepts 1.59 Ah (~28% SOC) and shows plating from ~8% SOC onward. Cause: eta_neg(20 A) ~0.35 V exceeds U_anode (~0.15-0.20 V) of the empty-to-quarter-full anode -> transport/kinetic-limited, formulation-scale root cause -> Stage-2 fallback with electrolyte sigma/t+ candidates (parameter bridge; no new molecule, molecular funnel skipped). Candidate ladder E<F<G<H bundles the two formulation overrides, then cooling for the DFN Tmax gap, then anode/separator transport. All parameter values declared before running: 1.8 S/m and t+ 0.45 = formulation-domain estimates (literature direction recorded in roles); h=100 = liquid-cooling domain; separator 8 um and porosity 0.35/AMVF 0.65 = architecture choices (widest DOF); names per PyBaMM parameter set (run-pyamm validates).
